This is your chance to work with the next generation of technologies for intelligent, cloud\-scale software engineering.

 You'll work on the open source Hydro framework and its integration with Amazon's Kiro family of coding agents. Working directly with customers running some of the world's biggest distributed systems, you'll uncover real\-world development challenges and translate them into product capabilities—staying true to Amazon's customer\-obsessed approach.
